items.title: Personality Correlates of Functional Status in Patients With Early-Stage Behavioral Variant Frontotemporal Dementia.
items.abstract: Functional impairment emerges early in behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD), significantly disrupting independence and quality of life. Although personality change is a core feature of bvFTD, its relationship with everyday functioning remains incompletely understood. This study aimed to characterize disease-related changes in personality and examine the associations of premorbid and current personality traits with functional status in early-stage bvFTD. In this retrospective study conducted at the University of California, San Francisco, Fein Memory and Aging Center, patients who met criteria for at least possible bvFTD, had a Mini-Mental State Examination score >18, and an available knowledgeable informant were evaluated at their earliest visit. Informants completed the Big 5 Inventory to assess premorbid and current personality. Functional status was evaluated using the informant-rated Functional Activities Questionnaire (FAQ), measuring instrumental activities of daily living. Linear regression was used to examine associations between premorbid personality and FAQ scores, and hierarchical regression was used to evaluate whether current personality explained variance beyond demographics and premorbid traits. Multiple comparisons were addressed using the Benjamini-Yekutieli procedure. The sample included 111 patients with bvFTD (mean age, 63.03 years; 33.33% female). Substantial disease-related personality changes were observed across all traits, including marked reductions in conscientiousness, openness, extraversion, and agreeableness, alongside increased neuroticism (all  Disease-related reductions in conscientiousness may reflect executive and motivational dysfunction directly relevant to real-world disability. Personality measures may provide clinically meaningful insight into functional risk and complement traditional severity indices in bvFTD. Limitations include the cross-sectional design, retrospective assessment of premorbid personality, and shared-informant reporting of personality and functional status. Longitudinal studies incorporating performance-based functional measures are needed to validate these findings.
items.summary_ja:
背景：行動変異型前頭側頭型認知症（bvFTD）では、機能障害が早期に現れ、生活の自立性や質を著しく損なう。性格変化はbvFTDの主要症状だが、日常機能との関連は十分に解明されていない。  
方法：カリフォルニア大学サンフランシスコ校のFein Memory and Aging Centerで、bvFTDの診断基準を満たし、Mini-Mental State Examinationが18点以上の111名の患者を対象に、知識のある情報提供者がBig 5 Inventoryで発症前後の性格を評価。機能状態は情報提供者によるFunctional Activities Questionnaire（FAQ）で測定。線形回帰と階層的回帰分析で性格特性と機能状態の関連を検討した。  
結果：全ての性格特性において疾患関連の変化が認められ、誠実性、開放性、外向性、協調性は著しく低下し、神経症傾向は増加した。特に誠実性の低下は実行機能や動機付けの障害を反映し、日常生活の障害に直結していた。  
結論：性格評価はbvFTDの機能リスクを示す臨床的指標として有用であり、従来の重症度指標を補完する可能性がある。横断的かつ回顧的評価の限界があり、今後は縦断的かつ実績ベースの機能評価を用いた研究が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 初期の行動変異型前頭側頭型認知症（bvFTD）患者111名を対象に、病前および現在の性格特性と日常機能障害の関連を調査した。病気に伴い誠実性、開放性、外向性、協調性が低下し、神経症傾向が増加。特に誠実性の低下は実行機能障害と関連し、日常生活の自立に影響を与える可能性が示唆された。性格評価は機能リスクの把握に有用であり、従来の重症度指標を補完する。

items.title: Severity-Based Triage for Direct Transportation to Nearest Comprehensive Stroke Center: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.abstract: The efficacy of endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) for acute ischemic stroke due to large vessel occlusion (LVO) is time dependent. Patients initially transported to a primary stroke center (PSC) may require secondary transfer, potentially delaying EVT. For severely affected patients, bypassing the PSC for direct transport to a comprehensive stroke center may expedite EVT but risks delaying IV thrombolysis. Effects of prehospital bypass strategies on functional outcomes are thus uncertain. For this systematic review and meta-analysis, PubMed and Web of Science were searched until December 2025. Randomized and nonrandomized studies comparing transport to the nearest stroke center with transport to a more distant comprehensive stroke center in patients with suspected stroke were included. Two investigators independently screened records, selected eligible studies, extracted summary data, and assessed risk of bias. Random-effects meta-analysis was used to quantify associations between prehospital bypass, endovascular therapy, and functional outcomes. Literature search identified 1,991 distinct reports. Of 18 eligible studies, 2 were randomized controlled trials (RCTs, n = 1,540 patients), 11 before-after studies (n = 11,837), and 5 cross-sectional studies (n = 1,139), comprising a total of 14,516 patients (52% men/48% women). Risk of bias was high in nonrandomized studies. Patients undergoing prehospital bypass and control patients had similar likelihoods of receiving EVT (odds ratio [OR] 1.52, 95% CI 0.98-2.35) or thrombolysis (OR 1.12, 0.92-1.35). Prehospital bypass was associated with earlier groin puncture (median difference -63.9 minutes, 95% CI -84.1 to -43.7). Time to needle in bypass patients was longer than in control patients in RCTs (median delay 34 minutes, 23.1-44.9 minutes), but similar in nonrandomized studies. Functional independence (modified Rankin Scale 0-2) at 90 days was more frequent in bypass patients (OR 1.23, 1.04-1.45). In patients with intracerebral hemorrhage, bypass was associated with increased mortality (risk ratio 1.30, 1.02-1.64). For patients with LVO stroke, benefits of expedited thrombectomy may outweigh possible risks associated with longer prehospital transport times. However, evidence is insufficient to recommend the routine implementation of prehospital bypass protocols. Further research is needed to determine circumstances under which direct access to comprehensive stroke centers should be prioritized for patients with severe stroke symptoms.
items.summary_ja: 背景：急性虚血性脳卒中の大血管閉塞（LVO）に対する血管内血栓除去術（EVT）は時間依存性であり、初期に一次脳卒中センター（PSC）へ搬送された患者は二次搬送が必要となり治療遅延のリスクがある。重症患者ではPSCを経由せず包括的脳卒中センターへ直接搬送することでEVTの迅速化が期待されるが、静脈内血栓溶解療法（IVT）の遅延リスクも懸念される。方法：PubMedおよびWeb of Scienceで2025年12月までの関連研究を検索し、最寄りの脳卒中センター搬送と遠方の包括的センターへの直接搬送を比較した18件（RCT2件、前後比較11件、横断5件、計14,516例）を対象にメタ解析を実施。結果：EVTやIVTの実施率は両群で有意差なく、直接搬送群はEVT開始までの時間が約64分短縮されたが、IVT開始までの時間はRCTで約34分遅延した。90日後の機能的独立（mRS 0-2）は直接搬送群で有意に多く（OR 1.23）、一方、脳内出血患者では死亡率が増加した（RR 1.30）。結論：LVO患者においては迅速な血栓除去の利益が搬送時間延長のリスクを上回る可能性があるが、直接搬送のルーチン化には証拠が不十分であり、重症患者の搬送戦略を最適化するためのさらなる研究が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 急性虚血性脳卒中に対する血管内血栓除去術（EVT）は時間依存性であり、一次脳卒中センター（PSC）経由の二次搬送は遅延を招く可能性がある。本研究は、重症患者のためにPSCを経由せず包括的脳卒中センターへ直接搬送する戦略の効果を系統的レビューとメタ解析で検証した。結果、直接搬送はEVT開始時間を短縮し、90日後の機能的自立率を改善したが、脳内出血患者では死亡率増加のリスクも示された。現時点での証拠は限定的であり、さらなる研究が必要である。

items.title: Factors Associated With Rate of Multiple Sclerosis Onset in a Cohort With Prior Infectious Mononucleosis Identified in Administrative Data.
items.abstract: Evidence suggests that Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection is a necessary, but not sufficient, exposure for developing multiple sclerosis (MS). Although many cases of EBV infection are asymptomatic, people with infectious mononucleosis (IM) often seek medical attention and thus can be studied on the population level. We aimed to characterize factors influencing the rate of MS development in a large population-based cohort with IM. In this retrospective cohort study, outpatient and inpatient cases of IM (ICD-9 code 075 and ICD-10-CA code B27) were identified from health claims data in Ontario, Canada, from April 1, 1992, to March 31, 2017. MS cases after IM were identified using a validated algorithm from May 1, 1992, to March 31, 2022. We evaluated the rate of MS in an IM-exposed cohort using a cause-specific hazards model incorporating age at IM (younger than 10 years, 10-25 years, and older than 25 years), sex, rural vs urban residence, neighborhood income, immigrant status, and mental health care use. We identified 671,410 cases of IM, with mean (SD) age of 19.9 (18.8) years; 53.5% were female. Of the 671,410, 2,470 (0.4%) developed MS over a median (interquarile range [IQR]) follow-up of 16.7 (10.1-23.3) years. The median time from IM to MS was 11.4 (IQR 6.5-16.8) years. Female sex (hazard ratio [HR] 1.9, 95% CI 1.8-2.1), age at IM (age 10-25 years vs < 10 years: HR 6.0; 95% CI 5.2-6.9), and mental health care use (HR 1.2; 95% CI 1.1-1.3) were associated with a greater rate of developing MS after IM, while being an immigrant was associated with a lower rate (HR 0.5; 95% CI 0.4-0.7). In a population-based cohort, the median time from IM exposure to MS was just over 1 decade. Mental health conditions may be associated with a higher rate of developing MS, in addition to being a feature of the MS prodrome. Our results may inform risk stratification for developing MS after IM and thus facilitate secondary prevention in high-risk individuals. Limitations include the ability to capture only recognized infectious mononucleosis, which may limit generalizability to asymptomatic or mild cases of EBV infection.
items.summary_ja:
背景：多発性硬化症（MS）の発症にはエプスタイン・バーウイルス（EBV）感染が必要とされるが、すべての感染者が発症するわけではない。症状の出る伝染性単核球症（IM）患者を対象に、MS発症率に影響を与える要因を検討した。  
方法：カナダ・オンタリオ州の医療請求データから1992～2017年にIMと診断された67万1410例を抽出し、追跡期間中のMS発症を検証。年齢、性別、居住地、所得、移民状況、精神医療利用の影響を多変量ハザードモデルで解析した。  
結果：IM患者の0.4％（2470例）が中央値16.7年の追跡期間中にMSを発症。IMからMSまでの中央値は11.4年。女性（HR 1.9）、IM発症年齢10～25歳（HR 6.0）、精神医療利用（HR 1.2）がMS発症率の上昇と関連し、移民は発症率低下（HR 0.5）と関連した。  
結論：IM後のMS発症までに約10年を要し、精神疾患の存在がMS発症リスクを高める可能性が示唆された。これらの知見はIM患者のMS発症リスク評価や二次予防に役立つが、無症候性EBV感染者への一般化には限界がある。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、カナダ・オンタリオ州の医療データを用いて、伝染性単核球症（IM）既往者における多発性硬化症（MS）発症率に影響する要因を検討した。67万人超のIM患者のうち0.4%がMSを発症し、発症までの中央値は約11年。女性、10～25歳でのIM発症、精神医療利用がMS発症リスクを高め、移民はリスクを低減した。精神疾患はMSの前駆症状である可能性も示唆され、IM後のMSリスク層別化や二次予防に資する結果である。

items.title: Evaluating Age-Related Motor System Changes Using Gait as a Functionally Relevant Marker.
items.abstract: Aging causes gait and mobility decline, which often precedes cognitive impairment and dementia. Biological "age gaps" (the difference between biological and chronological age) are traditionally measured using neuroimaging and electroencephalography, quantified gait metrics have not been used for this purpose. We hypothesize that specific gait metrics can effectively quantify biological aging and predict future cognitive impairment risk. We analyzed gait data from the Mayo Clinic Study of Aging, a population-based cohort in Olmsted County, MN. Participants without known gait disorder, recruited between 2007 and 2025, were included. We used these data to develop a machine learning-based age prediction model. This gait-based age prediction model was used to devise the "gait age gap," a quantified metric of gait abnormality defined as the difference between age as predicted by gait performance ("gait age") and chronological age. We used the gait age gap to evaluate the risk of future cognitive impairment. We analyzed 19,637 walk trials from 5,794 unique participants (49% female), with a mean age of 78 (±8) years. Gait age was primarily driven by changes in measures of stability. A larger gait age gap was associated with impaired cognitive and functional status. In longitudinal analysis, each gait age gap year exceeding chronological age increased the risk of converting from a normal to cognitively impaired (CI) state by 7% per year. Gait age gap outperformed baseline velocity in distinguishing normal from CI groups and was associated with future risk of conversion from normal to a CI state hazard ratio = 1.07 (95% CI 1.03-1.13) for gait age gap vs hazard ratio = 0.99 (95% CI 0.98-1.00) for velocity. The gait age gap is a functionally relevant marker of age-related motor system changes that quantifies deviations from expected gait performance for a given chronological age. It is associated with a higher risk of future cognitive impairment among cognitively normal individuals. This study includes a relatively homogeneous cohort of predominantly Caucasian participants. To assess generalizability and the trajectory of motoric aging across sociodemographic groups, these findings need to be replicated in diverse cohorts. Wearable sensor technologies could also make such measures more scalable.
items.summary_ja:
背景：加齢に伴い歩行や運動機能が低下し、これは認知障害や認知症の前兆となることが多い。従来、生物学的年齢の差異（生物学的年齢と実年齢のギャップ）は神経画像や脳波で評価されてきたが、歩行の定量的指標は用いられていなかった。  
方法：ミネソタ州オルムステッド郡のMayo Clinic Study of Agingの参加者（2007～2025年、歩行障害なし）5,794名の19,637回の歩行データを用い、機械学習による歩行年齢予測モデルを構築。歩行年齢と実年齢の差を「歩行年齢ギャップ」と定義し、認知機能障害リスクとの関連を検証した。  
結果：歩行年齢は主に安定性の指標に影響され、歩行年齢ギャップが大きいほど認知・機能障害と関連。歩行年齢ギャップが実年齢を1年超えるごとに認知障害への移行リスクが7％増加し、歩行速度よりも認知障害の予測精度が高かった。  
結論：歩行年齢ギャップは加齢に伴う運動系変化を反映する機能的マーカーであり、認知正常者の将来の認知障害リスク評価に有用である。今後、多様な集団での検証とウェアラブル技術による測定の普及が期待される。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、歩行パフォーマンスを用いた機械学習モデルにより「歩行年齢ギャップ」（歩行年齢と実年齢の差）を算出し、加齢に伴う運動系変化を定量化した。歩行年齢ギャップの増加は認知機能低下リスクの上昇と関連し、従来の歩行速度よりも認知障害予測に優れていた。主に安定性の変化が指標を牽引し、認知正常者の将来的な認知障害発症リスク評価に有用である。今後は多様な集団での検証が必要である。

items.title: Association of Prethrombectomy Hemorrhagic Infarction on MRI With Further Transformation and Functional Outcomes: A Multicenter Study.
items.abstract: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) is the standard of care for acute ischemic stroke from large vessel occlusion (LVO). Although postprocedural parenchymal hematoma (PH) predicts poor outcomes, pretreatment hemorrhagic infarction (HI), defined as petechial bleeding within infarcted tissue, is traditionally viewed as a benign radiologic finding. Its significance on sensitive preintervention MRI remains underexplored. We evaluated whether pretreatment MRI HI is associated with 90-day functional dependence, post-MT PH, and symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage (SICH). This retrospective cohort study included consecutive patients with anterior circulation LVO undergoing MT at 2 stroke centers (2015-2022). Patients required pre-MT T2*-weighted MRI. HI was graded (types I/II) per European Cooperative Acute Stroke Study III criteria in blinded fashion. The primary outcome was 90-day functional dependence (modified Rankin Scale 3-6). Secondary outcomes were post-MT ipsilateral PH and SICH. We used multivariable Bayesian and frequentist logistic regression to adjust for age, sex, NIH Stroke Scale, baseline disability, comorbidities, infarct volume, and procedural factors. Among 479 patients (median age 72 years; 46% female; 50% received IV thrombolysis), pretreatment HI was identified in 25 (5.2%), with excellent inter-rater agreement (Cohen κ = 0.9). Functional dependence at 90 days occurred in 47% of the total cohort, ipsilateral PH in 9.4%, and SICH in 3.1%. In multivariable analysis, pre-MT HI was independently associated with 90-day functional dependence (Bayesian adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 6.66, 95% credible interval [CrI] 2.15-24.28, Pr[OR > 1] = 1.00; frequentist aOR 5.95, 95% CI 1.91-18.52,  HI detected on pretreatment MRI is an independent predictor of poor long-term functional outcomes and correlates with post-MT PH/SICH. Pre-MT HI may reflect significant blood-brain barrier disruption and microvascular fragility, serving as a marker of reperfusion vulnerability. Limitations include the retrospective design and the relatively low frequency of HI, PH, and SICH, which were addressed using Bayesian modeling to quantify uncertainty. Although not a contraindication to MT, identifying HI may aid in periprocedural risk stratification and serve as a candidate marker for future neuroprotective trials.
items.summary_ja: 背景：急性虚血性脳卒中に対する機械的血栓回収術（MT）は標準治療であるが、治療前のMRIで認められる出血性梗塞（HI）が予後に与える影響は十分に検討されていない。方法：2015～2022年に2施設で前方循環大血管閉塞の患者479例を対象に、治療前のT2*強調MRIでHIの有無を評価し、90日後の機能的依存度（mRS 3-6）、術後の脳内出血（PH）および症候性脳内出血（SICH）との関連を多変量ロジスティック回帰で解析した。結果：HIは5.2%に認められ、90日後の機能的依存度と術後PH/SICHの独立した予測因子であった（調整オッズ比約6）。結論：治療前MRIでのHIは血液脳関門の障害や微小血管の脆弱性を反映し、長期の機能予後不良および術後出血リスクのマーカーとなる。MTの禁忌ではないが、リスク層別化や神経保護療法の候補指標として有用である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、急性虚血性脳卒中に対する機械的血栓回収術（MT）前のMRIで検出される出血性梗塞（HI）が、90日後の機能的依存や術後の脳内出血（PH、SICH）と関連するかを検討した。479例中5.2%にHIを認め、HIは独立して機能的予後不良および術後出血リスクの増加と関連した。HIは血液脳関門の障害を反映し、再灌流脆弱性の指標となり得るため、MTのリスク評価や神経保護治療の対象として有用である。

items.title: Performance of Diagnostic Criteria for Autoimmune Encephalitis in Patients With Suspected Rapidly Progressive Dementia.
items.abstract: The Graus criteria for possible autoimmune encephalitis (AE) are increasingly used to identify patients most likely to benefit from autoantibody testing and empiric immunotherapy. However, the performance of Graus criteria in patients with suspected rapidly progressive dementia (RPD) is unknown. We aimed to determine the diagnostic performance of the Graus criteria for possible AE in patients with suspected RPD and to identify the factors associated with progression to autoimmune dementia (AiD). In this observational cohort study, patients ≥18 years with suspected RPD were enrolled and evaluated at 2 tertiary care centers (Washington University in St. Louis, MO, and Mayo Clinic Jacksonville, FL) from 2016 to 2024. Clinical data, brain imaging, electroencephalograms, and biofluid measures were reviewed, and consensus diagnoses were assigned by independent reviewers. We evaluated the diagnostic performance of the Graus criteria for possible AE against the consensus diagnosis. Among patients with AE, multivariable logistic regression models were used to identify factors independently associated with progression to AiD. Two hundred sixty-one patients with suspected RPD were enrolled (mean age 61.1 years, 46% female, 83% non-Hispanic White), including 74 patients (28%) with AE. The Graus criteria for possible AE demonstrated 89% sensitivity, 96% specificity, and 94% accuracy for the diagnosis of AE in patients with suspected RPD. Two patients with AE died within 3 months of symptom onset. Cognitive impairment persisted beyond 3 months in 47 of 72 surviving patients with AE (65%), meeting proposed criteria for AiD. In multivariable analysis, older age (odds ratio [OR] 1.4 per decade, 95% CI 1.0-1.9), longer time to initiation of immunomodulatory treatments (OR 1.4 per month, 95% CI 1.1-1.9), and treatment with rituximab (OR 4.3, 95% CI 1.2-15.1) were independently associated with AiD. The Graus criteria for possible AE reliably identified patients with suspected RPD due to AE. In patients with AE, older age, delays in the initiation of immunomodulatory therapies, and rituximab use (a proxy for severe/refractory AE) were independently associated with progression to AiD. These findings apply to patients evaluated at specialized referral centers and warrant confirmation in broader settings. This study provides Class III evidence that the Graus criteria accurately distinguish AE from other causes of RPD.
items.summary_ja:
背景：自己免疫性脳炎（AE）の診断に用いられるGraus基準は、自己抗体検査や免疫療法の適応患者選定に有用とされるが、急速進行性認知症（RPD）疑い患者での性能は不明であった。  
方法：2016～2024年に米国の2つの三次医療機関で、18歳以上のRPD疑い患者261名（うちAE患者74名）を対象に観察コホート研究を実施。臨床データや画像検査、脳波、生体液検査を解析し、独立した評価者によるコンセンサス診断とGraus基準の診断性能を比較。AE患者の自己免疫性認知症（AiD）への進行因子を多変量ロジスティック回帰で検討した。  
結果：Graus基準は感度89％、特異度96％、正確度94％と高い診断性能を示した。AE患者のうち65％が3か月以上認知障害を持続しAiDと診断。AiD進行には高齢、免疫調節療法開始の遅れ、重症例の指標であるリツキシマブ使用が独立して関連した。  
結論：Graus基準はRPD疑い患者におけるAE診断に有効であり、AiD進行には年齢や治療開始時期、重症度が影響する。専門施設での結果であり、他施設での検証が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、急速進行性認知症（RPD）疑い患者における自己免疫性脳炎（AE）の診断基準であるGraus基準の有用性を検証した。261例中74例がAEと診断され、Graus基準は感度89％、特異度96％、精度94％を示した。AE患者の65％が自己免疫性認知症（AiD）へ進行し、高齢、免疫調節治療開始の遅れ、リツキシマブ使用がAiD進行の独立因子であった。Graus基準は専門施設でのAE診断に有効である。

items.title: Sex Differences in Blood Pressure Dynamics and Outcomes After Endovascular Thrombectomy.
items.abstract: Optimal blood pressure (BP) management after endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) for acute ischemic stroke (AIS) remains controversial, and whether early BP dynamics differentially affect outcomes among female and male participants is unclear. This was an exploratory secondary analysis of ENCHANTED2/MT, a multicenter, open-label, blinded-end point randomized trial conducted in 44 tertiary hospitals in China. Eligible adults had AIS due to large-vessel occlusion, successful reperfusion after EVT, and persistent elevated systolic BP (SBP) within 3 hours after reperfusion. Serial BP measurements obtained during the first 72 hours after randomization were used to estimate patient-specific mean BP trajectories and short-term BP variability with a location-scale mixed-effects modeling approach. Associations of mean BP, BP variability, and randomized intensive vs standard BP lowering strategy with clinical outcomes were examined, with sex being evaluated as an effect modifier. The primary outcome was the 90-day modified Rankin Scale (mRS). Among 816 patients (mean age 67.6 ± 12.0 years; 38% female), intensive BP management was associated with worse 90-day ordinal mRS outcome among male participants (adjusted common odds ratio [acOR] 1.91; 95% CI 1.29-2.83), whereas the corresponding estimate among female participants was closer to null (acOR 0.94; 95% CI 0.56-1.57; ratio of acORs 0.49; 95% CI 0.26-0.94). In separate postrandomization BP exposure models, each 5 mm Hg higher mean SBP was associated with worse 90-day mRS outcome among male participants (acOR 1.11; 95% CI 1.03-1.20), whereas no clear adverse association was observed among female participants (acOR 0.95; 95% CI 0.85-1.05; ratio of acORs 0.85; 95% CI 0.75-0.97). SBP variability showed weaker and less consistent sex differential associations. Findings across secondary outcomes were directionally similar but exploratory. In this exploratory secondary analysis of ENCHANTED2/MT, randomized BP management strategy and early post-thrombectomy BP dynamics showed sex-stratified associations with outcomes. These associations may reflect biological sex and sex-related differences in baseline clinical and vascular characteristics. These findings are hypothesis generating and should be confirmed in prospectively designed studies before informing sex-specific BP management after EVT. ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04140110; the Registration Date, October 22, 2019.
items.summary_ja:
背景：急性虚血性脳卒中に対する血管内血栓除去術（EVT）後の最適な血圧管理は未だ議論があり、性別による血圧変動の影響差は不明である。  
方法：中国の44施設で実施された多施設ランダム化試験ENCHANTED2/MTの二次解析を行い、EVT後3時間以内に収縮期血圧（SBP）が持続的に高い816例（平均年齢67.6歳、女性38％）を対象に、72時間の血圧動態を混合効果モデルで解析。血圧の平均値、変動性、強化型と標準型の血圧管理戦略と90日後の機能的予後（修正Rankin尺度：mRS）との関連を性別で検討した。  
結果：男性では強化型血圧管理が90日mRS悪化と関連（調整共通オッズ比1.91）、女性では関連がほぼ認められなかった（acOR 0.94）。また、男性では平均SBPが5mmHg上昇するごとに予後悪化が示されたが、女性では明確な関連はなかった。SBP変動性の性差は弱く一貫性に欠けた。  
結論：EVT後の血圧管理と早期血圧動態は性別で異なる予後影響を示し、これは生物学的性差や基礎疾患の違いを反映している可能性がある。これらの知見は仮説生成的であり、性別特異的血圧管理の指針とするには前向き研究での検証が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 急性虚血性脳卒中に対する血管内血栓除去術（EVT）後の血圧管理の最適化は不明であり、本研究は性差による血圧動態と予後の関連を検討した。816例を対象に解析した結果、集中的血圧管理は男性で90日後の機能予後悪化と関連したが、女性では有意な影響が認められなかった。平均収縮期血圧の上昇も男性の予後悪化と関連したが、女性では明確な関連はなかった。性別に応じた血圧管理の必要性を示唆するが、今後の前向き研究での検証が求められる。

items.title: Pearls & Oy-sters: Anti-GABA
items.abstract: A previously healthy 5-year-old girl presented with several days of fever/malaise followed by acute neurologic decline. Head CT demonstrated fulminant right cerebellitis with edema and fourth-ventricle effacement concerning for impending herniation. She underwent emergent posterior fossa decompression. CSF showed mild pleocytosis, and MRI revealed right cerebellar nonenhancing T2/fluid-attenuated inversion recovery hyperintense lesions with evolving supratentorial cortical involvement. Despite empiric antimicrobials and initial immunotherapy (high-dose IV methylprednisolone and tocilizumab followed by IV immunoglobulin/plasma exchange), she developed progressive neuroinflammation with new seizures and markedly elevated CSF IL-6, prompting escalation to additional IL-6-directed therapy with tocilizumab and rescue intrathecal dexamethasone. She subsequently stabilized with radiographic improvement and meaningful neurologic recovery. Expanded antibody testing later confirmed anti-GABA
items.summary_ja:
背景：5歳の健康な女児が数日間の発熱・倦怠感の後、急激な神経症状の悪化を呈した。  
方法：頭部CTで右小脳の急性炎症と脳浮腫が認められ、緊急に後頭蓋窩減圧術を施行。髄液検査では軽度の細胞増加、MRIでは右小脳の非造影性T2/FLAIR高信号病変と大脳皮質の進行性病変を確認。経験的抗菌薬と免疫療法（高用量メチルプレドニゾロン、トシリズマブ、免疫グロブリン、血漿交換）を実施。  
結果：治療にもかかわらず神経炎症が進行し、新たな発作と髄液中IL-6の著明な上昇を認めたため、IL-6標的療法の強化と髄腔内デキサメタゾンを追加。これにより症状は安定し、画像所見も改善、神経学的回復が得られた。  
結論：最終的に抗GABA抗体が確認され、抗GABA抗体関連自己免疫性小脳炎の診断が確定した。早期の免疫療法とIL-6標的治療の併用が有効であった。
items.summary_short_ja: 5歳女児が発熱後に急性神経症状を呈し、右小脳炎と脳浮腫で緊急後頭蓋減圧術を受けた。髄液検査で軽度の細胞増加、MRIで右小脳および大脳皮質に炎症性病変を認めた。抗菌・免疫療法後も症状悪化し、IL-6高値に対しトシリズマブと髄腔内デキサメタゾンを追加。治療により症状改善し、抗GABA抗体陽性と判明した。

items.title: Age-Dependent Nonlinear Association Between Gait Impairment and Incident Dementia.
items.abstract: Gait impairment is associated with incident dementia, yet whether this association varies with age or follows a linear dose-response relationship remains unclear. The aim of this study was to examine the nonlinear dose-response relationship between Performance-Oriented Mobility Assessment (POMA) gait performance and incident dementia and to test whether this association is modified by age. This prospective cohort study used data from the Korean Longitudinal Study on Cognitive Aging and Dementia (baseline enrollment, 2010-2012; follow-up through 2020; median follow-up, 6.2 years). The primary outcome was incident dementia diagnosed by Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders IV (DSM-IV) criteria. Gait and balance were assessed using the POMA. Cause-specific Cox proportional hazards regression with death treated as a competing event was used. Restricted cubic splines (RCS) modeled the nonlinear dose-response relationship between gait performance and incident dementia, and RCS-by-age interaction terms were used to test age modification and estimate age-specific hazard ratios and 95% CIs. Of 6,818 eligible participants, 4,822 met inclusion criteria (mean (SD) age, 69.6 (6.3) years; 2,719 (56.4%) female; median follow-up 6.2 years [IQR, 3.8-8.1]). During follow-up, 251 developed dementia and 458 died. The gait-dementia association was significantly nonlinear ( Gait impairment predicted incident dementia in a nonlinear, age-dependent manner, with the association strongest in adults aged 65-75 years and not evident beyond approximately age 80 years. These findings suggest gait assessment may be most informative for dementia screening in younger-old adults. Limitations include an ethnically homogeneous cohort.
items.summary_ja:
【背景】歩行障害は認知症発症と関連するが、その関連性が年齢によって変化するかや線形的な用量反応関係かは不明である。  
【方法】韓国の認知加齢・認知症縦断研究のデータ（2010-2012年登録、中央値6.2年追跡）を用い、Performance-Oriented Mobility Assessment（POMA）による歩行評価とDSM-IV基準による認知症発症の関連を、競合リスクを考慮したコックス回帰と制限立方スプラインで非線形に解析。年齢による修飾効果も検討した。  
【結果】4,822名（平均年齢69.6歳、女性56.4%）中、追跡期間中に251名が認知症を発症。歩行障害と認知症発症の関連は非線形で、65～75歳で最も強く、80歳以上では関連が認められなかった。  
【結論】歩行評価は若年高齢者（65～75歳）の認知症スクリーニングに有用である可能性が示された。ただし、対象は単一民族集団である点が限界である。
items.summary_short_ja: 歩行障害と認知症発症の関連性は年齢により非線形で変化し、特に65～75歳で強く認められたが、80歳以上ではほぼ見られなかった。韓国の縦断研究で、歩行能力評価（POMA）と認知症発症を追跡し、年齢による修飾効果を解析した結果、若年高齢者における歩行評価が認知症スクリーニングに有用であることを示唆する。ただし、対象は単一民族集団に限られる。

items.title: Clinical Reasoning: A 69-Year-Old Female Patient With Rapid-Onset Levodopa-Responsive Rest Tremor, Parkinsonism, and Gait Freezing.
items.abstract: The evaluation of rapid-onset parkinsonism can be challenging, and the differential diagnosis encompasses a broad spectrum of etiology, management, and prognosis. We present a 69-year-old patient who developed rapid-onset resting tremor and parkinsonism with gait freezing. Her upper limb resting tremor began unilaterally but rapidly progressed to involve the contralateral limb and subsequently the lower limbs. This evolved within 3 months to also include generalized parkinsonism and a shuffling gait with prominent freezing and frequent falls. Her tremor was levodopa responsive; however, other symptoms were resistant to treatment. Through this case, we will demonstrate the diagnostic approach to rapid-onset parkinsonism, summarizing a comprehensive evaluation of history, examination, and investigations. Readers will consider atypical features revealed by examination and investigations, ultimately arriving at a conclusive and critical diagnosis not to be missed in the presentation of parkinsonism.
items.summary_ja:
背景：急速発症するパーキンソニズムの診断は困難であり、多様な原因や治療法、予後が考えられる。  
方法：69歳女性が片側の上肢安静時振戦から始まり、3か月以内に対側および下肢に進展し、全身性パーキンソニズムと歩行時のすくみ足、頻繁な転倒を呈した症例を報告。振戦はレボドパに反応したが、他の症状は治療抵抗性であった。詳細な病歴聴取、身体検査、検査を通じて診断アプローチを検討した。  
結果：急速進行するパーキンソニズムにおける非典型的所見を明らかにし、鑑別診断を絞り込む過程を示した。  
結論：本症例は急速発症パーキンソニズムの診断において見逃してはならない重要なポイントを示し、包括的評価の必要性を強調している。
items.summary_short_ja: 69歳女性が急速に発症したレボドパ反応性の安静時振戦、パーキンソニズム、歩行凍結を呈した症例を報告する。振戦は片側から始まり3か月で全身に広がり、歩行障害と頻回の転倒を伴った。振戦はレボドパに反応したが他症状は難治であり、詳細な病歴聴取、身体検査、検査を通じて迅速発症パーキンソニズムの鑑別診断と診断手順を示した。
